_about: Magic items askdnd knows by name (app/conditions.py). Our own short summaries of the 2024 rules, never book text. actions: Battle options the item gives; starts / ends: a condition or effect the action gives or ends (a pill on Battle); note: what the pill says about how long it lasts. on_use: what drinking or using a consumable (already a 'Use an item' option) starts. Chosen from a scan of every 2024 magic item (docs/reviews/2026-10-22-magic-item-effects.md).

actions.name: Turn Invisible
actions.note: Lasts until you take the ring off or take a Bonus Action to become visible. Attacking or casting a spell doesn't end it.
actions.text: Take a Magic action to give yourself the Invisible condition. It lasts until you take the ring off or take a Bonus Action to become visible. Unlike the Invisibility spell, attacking or casting a spell doesn't end it.

actions.name: Become visible
actions.text: Take a Bonus Action to end the Invisible condition the ring gave you.

actions.name: Pull up the hood
actions.meta: Magic action · 1 charge · Cloak of Invisibility
actions.note: 1 hour, or until you pull the hood down (no action needed) or take the cloak off.
actions.text: Take a Magic action and spend 1 charge to give yourself the Invisible condition for 1 hour. Pulling the hood down (no action) or taking the cloak off ends it.

actions.name: Fly
actions.note: Fly Speed 30 feet for 1 hour; if you're in the air when it ends, you descend 30 feet per round until you land.
actions.text: Take a Magic action and spend 1 charge for a Fly Speed of 30 feet for 1 hour.

actions.name: Spread the wings
actions.note: Fly Speed 60 feet for 1 hour, or until you end it with a Magic action. If you're aloft when they vanish, you fall; then 1d12 hours before you can use them again.
actions.text: Take a Magic action to turn the cloak into wings: a Fly Speed of 60 feet for 1 hour.

on_use.note: 1 hour. Ends early if you make an attack roll, deal damage or cast a spell.
1 hour. Attacking or casting doesn't end it.
2d4 minutes for you and everyone within 10 feet. It ends for a creature right after it makes an attack roll, deals damage or casts a spell.
10 minutes, no Concentration needed (the enlarge effect of Enlarge/Reduce).
